scope.purpose: Ask the user to complete or abandon a short task or decision before going back to the page.
useCases: Edit a record in a short form.
Show terms that must be accepted.
exclusions: Full-screen dialogs and multi-step wizards: compositions later.
alternatives: Alert for a message that needs no answer.

contract.scope: Dialog contract: bindable open, required title, description, size sm/md/lg (component tokens component.dialog.inline-size.*), alert, dismissible, closeLabel; header, scrolling body, footer ButtonGroup, backdrop color.surface.scrim; initial focus rule; native modal dialog in the top layer.
contract.provenance: User at the grouped wave 3 contract gate in the Claude Code session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c543GZBnpgBmqmSNfDLB (2026-11-03), on the review page https://claude.ai/artifact/3WoVBXoZev2vBWUUJny9A8 (version 3): "Je valide les 10 contrats. Ensuite : 1. ok (meme si le wording scrim n'est pas très parlant...) 2. Ok 3. Ok 4. Oui 5. Ok, à juger dans l'implémentation".
contract.note: The user finds the word scrim unclear; the documentation explains the role in plain words. A rename is not decided.

checks.name: npm run validate (schema, consistency, token coverage in 18 contexts, dependencies)
npm run build:tokens (coverage and contrast evidence)

decisionsTaken: Native modal dialog in the top layer (decision of 2026-10-31): inert page, focus trap and focus return from the platform; backdrop color.surface.scrim (open question 1).
Header (required title, optional description, close button), scrolling body, footer with one ButtonGroup aligned at the end; dividers appear only when the body scrolls (state scrolled).
Sizes sm, md, lg on the component tokens component.dialog.inline-size.{sm,md,lg} (400, 560, 720 px), capped by the viewport less space.layout.md.
alert true: alert dialog, never closed by a backdrop press; dismissible false removes the close button, Escape and the backdrop press.
Initial focus: the element the application marks, else the first focusable element of the body, then of the footer, else the panel.
Title typography.heading.sm, description typography.body.sm, body typography.body.md, padding space.layout.md, shadow.modal, radius.overlay, entry with motion.distance.md.
No trigger part: the application opens the dialog by setting open (a Button or a Menu item).

Open question 1 resolved (user, 2026-11-03: "ok (meme si le wording scrim n'est pas très parlant...)"): color.surface.scrim is the canonical modal backdrop; opacity.scrim stays for an image or video veil and is documented as not for overlays. The user finds the word scrim unclear: the foundations documentation explains it in plain words (the dimming layer behind a modal window); a rename is not decided.

Open question 2 resolved (user, 2026-11-03: "Ok"): when a Bits UI behavior disagrees with a contract rule, the contract wins; the component overrides or completes the primitive locally, pins the Bits UI version and covers the override with a browser test.
nextAction: Implementation phase (ggb-svelte): component folder, examples page, SSR and browser tests, self-contained preview; Firefox and WebKit smoke projects before the first overlay implementation gate; then the grouped wave 3 implementation review.
